For cancellation requests, email: care@nurosym.com.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Once an order has already shipped, changes or cancellations are generally no longer possible while it is in transit.  
If you no longer want the item after it ships, you still have a couple of options:
Refuse delivery when the courier arrives (if the courier allows it), and the package will be returned.
Accept the delivery and request a return after it arrives, following the return instructions provided with your order.
Because orders are typically dispatched within 1–3 business days, requests to modify or cancel need to be sent as soon as possible before shipment.
